brief:
Israeli forces carried out gunfire, artillery shelling, airstrikes, and demolitions across the Gaza Strip on the 332nd consecutive day of ceasefire violations, IMEMC News reported. The military operations targeted shelters and tents housing displaced Palestinians throughout the besieged enclave, according to the report.

The violations represent an ongoing pattern of military activity that has persisted despite the ceasefire agreement between the parties. Gunfire and shelling have been concentrated in multiple areas across Gaza, with demolition crews also active in various locations. No immediate casualty figures or specific locations were provided in the initial report of the day's violations.
